caption:
Bor ve çinko, Venta Borinc'de bir arada.

Venta Borinc; bor (B) ve çinko (Zn-sülfat) içeren bir mikro bitki besin maddeleri karışımıdır. Ambalajdaki B ve Zn altıgen rozetleri de bu iki elementi işaret eder.

Ürünün toprak ve/veya yaprak analizi yaptırılarak kullanılması tavsiye edilir. Kullanmadan önce etiketi okuyunuz.

Detaylı bilgi: www.mtmagro.com

#Venta #MTMAgro #Borinc #Bor #Çinko #BitkiBesleme
rationale: The idea is the pack's own story, two elements in one bag: the real Venta Borinc bag is the single focal point at about 56% of the artboard height, right-aligned to the margin on white, while the B and Zn hexagons from the label form a honeycomb pair on its left that leads the eye into it. A wide black italic display-caps headline (BOR VE ÇİNKO / BİR ARADA) quotes the VENTA logotype, and the bottom closes with the green label band and raised centre tab plus the VENTA logo and www.mtmagro.com sign-off. The badge letters are set in ink rather than the pack's white, because white on amber (about 2.2:1) and on green (about 2.7:1) fails the 3:1 contrast rule; BORINC is typed in capitals so that lang=tr uppercasing cannot turn it into BORİNC. No numbers, doses or benefits are stated; everything on the image comes from facts.json.
